31792-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry for Youth and Family, adjusting spending and commitment amounts across articles in line with the autumn supplementary budget (Najaarsnota). It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 December 2008.
q: The departmental budget statement of the budget for Youth and Family (XVII) for the year 2008 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van de begroting voor Jeugd en Gezin (XVII) voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

31879-(R1877).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2001 London International Convention on civil liability for bunker oil pollution damage. It concerns ship-owner strict liability, compulsory insurance and jurisdiction rules, and does not itself shift powers to the executive.
31879-(R1877).j: The memorandum justifies approval by explaining the convention's liability, limitation, time-bar and jurisdiction rules and their relation to EU Regulation 44/2001, without any new executive powers.
q: The International Convention on Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage, 2001, done at London on 23 March 2001, whose English and French texts and Dutch translation are published in Tractatenblad 2005, 329, is approved for the entire Kingdom.

Het op 23 maart 2001 te Londen tot stand gekomen Internationaal verdrag inzake de wettelijke aansprakelijkheid voor schade door verontreiniging door bunkerolie, 2001, waarvan de Engelse en Franse tekst en de vertaling in het Nederlands zijn geplaatst in Tractatenblad 2005, 329, wordt goedgekeurd voor het gehele Koninkrijk.

parties: Asks whether victims are left bearing part of the damage under limitation regimes and how illegal discharges and their proof can be detected and enforced.
What evidence problems and bottlenecks arise when establishing liability based on observed discharges?
Welke bewijsproblemen en -knelpunten doen zich voor bij het vaststellen van de aansprakelijkheid op grond van waargenomen lozingen?

Asks why the convention has no own limitation regime and no supplementary compensation fund, why liability can be capped, and how state vessels and insurance certificates are controlled and sanctioned.
Furthermore they ask how often per year the insurer must pay compensation and whether this number is capped.
Voorts vragen zij hoe vaak per jaar de verzekeraar een vergoeding dient uit te keren en of dit aantal keren is gemaximeerd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised the Kingdom to promote co-application of the 2001 Bunkers Convention to the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba, given their exposure to busy shipping routes. The government agreed, reporting that the Netherlands Antilles finds co-application desirable while Aruba has not yet answered.
concerns: The Raad advises promoting co-application of the Bunkers Convention in all parts of the Kingdom, including the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba.

31924-C.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statement of the provincial fund (provinciefonds) by adjusting the commitment and expenditure figures and sets the 2008 commitment amount for general grants at €1,170,939,000. It takes effect the day after publication and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for general grants is set for the 2008 grant year at €1,170,939,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2008 vastgesteld op € 1 170 939 000.

32395-XVII.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statement for the Ministry of Youth and Family (first supplementary budget, linked to the Spring Memorandum), adjusting obligations, expenditure and receipts across policy articles 1 to 3 and non-policy articles 98 and 99. It also sets the usual budget units, entry into force on 1 June 2010 and retroactive effect where the gazette is published later.
32395-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Subsidieregeling VWS-subsidies and lists provincially financed youth care institutions, without addressing delegation or new powers.
q: These obligations are derived as far as possible from the Subsidy Scheme for VWS subsidies.
Deze verplichtingen zijn zoveel als mogelijk ontleend aan de Subsidieregeling VWS-subsidies.

32565-A.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructure Fund, adjusting appropriations and receipts across articles such as main waterways, main road network, railways and regional infrastructure, following the autumn budget memorandum. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and specifies entry into force on 1 December 2010, with retroactive effect if published later.
32565-A.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the amendments by pointing to project delays and deviations from the budgeted cash flow, and to the replacement rather than renovation of lock doors.
q: An important cause of the higher expenditure is that renovating the doors of the Bernhard lock was not sufficient and they had to be replaced.
Belangrijke oorzaak voor de hogere uitgaven bij de laatst genoemde is dat niet volstaan kon worden met renovatie van de deuren in de Bernhardsluis, maar dat deze vervangen moesten worden.

32710-I.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Royal Household (Koning I), adjusting commitments and expenditure figures across its articles in thousands of euros. It applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year and entered into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Because wage and price developments deviate slightly from what was assumed when the budget was drawn up, the budget amount is adjusted downward by 7.
Doordat de loon- en prijsontwikkeling enigszins afwijkt van datgene waarmee bij het opstellen van de begroting rekening is gehouden, wordt het begrotingsbedrag met 7 neerwaarts aangepast.

32710-XVIII.s: This supplementary budget bill (Slotwet 2010) adjusts the 2010 budget for the chapter Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration (XVIII) and the baten-lastendiensten budget. It also grants the Comptabiliteitswet reporting relief for that chapter's 2010 annual report.
q: Notwithstanding article 54(1) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the annual report of the Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration chapter for 2010 may limit the per-policy-article insight in the explanatory notes to parts c to f of that paragraph.

In afwijking van artikel 54, eerste lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 geldt voor het jaarverslag van het begrotingshoofdstuk Wonen, Wijken en Integratie (XVIII) voor het jaar 2010 dat het in dat artikellid bedoelde inzicht per beleidsartikel in de toelichting bij de verantwoordingsstaat beperkt kan blijven tot de onderdelen c tot en met f van dat artikellid.

32780-B.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), adjusting expenditure and revenue figures and setting the commitment amounts for the general grant, integration grants and decentralisation grants for the 2011 grant year. It takes effect on 1 June 2011, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for the year 2011
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2011

32868-(R1959).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom three Antarctic Treaty measures: Annex VI on liability from environmental emergencies, Measure 15(2009) on shore landings of passengers from passenger ships, and Measure 16(2009) amending Annex II on conservation of Antarctic flora and fauna. It also provides that future adjustments to the Annex VI liability limits do not require approval by the Staten-Generaal.
32868-(R1959).j: The memorandum explains that Annex VI's liability-limit adjustments are made under the treaty's own procedure, so Dutch approval is not required.
d: adjustments to Annex VI liability limits
p: Future amendments to the liability limits of Annex VI take effect without parliamentary approval, removing legislative oversight over those changes.

parties: Asks who is responsible for checking compliance with the obligation on organisers to prevent environmental emergencies, and what role the Netherlands plays.
Who is responsible for monitoring compliance with these measures?
Wie is er verantwoordelijk voor de controle op de naleving van deze maatregelen?
Has no questions on the bill itself; reserves questions for a related bill.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.](see related bill)
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
Welcomes the approval of the Antarctic Treaty measures as an improvement on the old situation.
What is before us is in their view an improvement over the old situation.
Hetgeen voorligt is naar hun mening een verbetering ten aanzien van de oude situatie.
Has no questions or remarks on the bill.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.

Asks for strict protection of Antarctica, clarity on the Dutch negotiating position, progress on a mining ban beyond 2048, enforcement of the 500-passenger rule, and action on non-party states and permanent tourist facilities.
They still have some questions and remarks on the proposal.
Zij hebben nog enkele vragen en opmerkingen bij het voorstel.

33090-G.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds (VAT compensation fund), reducing expenditure and receipts by a set amount in thousands of euros and fixing the amounts in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published on or after that date.
q: The budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds for the year 2011 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

33280-F.s: The bill amends the 2012 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) by adding 7,508 thousand euros to the appropriation for animal disease surveillance and control, raising it from 9,700 to 17,208 thousand euros. It sets the entry into force on 1 June 2012 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that a need has arisen to amend the Animal Health Fund
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van het Diergezondheidsfonds

33640-F.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds), raising the expenditure and revenue figures under article 1 by 4,636 thousand euros in line with the Spring Memorandum. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force as 1 June 2013 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Animal Health Fund
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds

33805-C.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), adjusting expenditure and revenue figures and fixing the commitment amounts for general and integration/decentralisation grants. It also makes the amendment effective from 1 December 2013, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
33805-C.j: The memorandum justifies the budget change by the Najaarsnota and by compensating provinces for supervision tasks transferred from the state under the revitalisation of generic oversight.

33940-C.s: The bill amends the 2014 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), adjusting the general grant and decentralisation grants and setting commitment amounts, effective from 1 June 2014. It is a budgetary adjustment linked to the Voorjaarsnota, with the memorandum explaining cuts to the general grant and transfers of tasks such as VTH supervision to municipalities.
33940-C.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Voorjaarsnota and the compensation of provincial administrative costs for transferred tasks, not by any delegation of power.
q: With the Voorjaarsnota 2014, the general grant is adjusted downward by € -73,000 and the decentralisation grants upward by € 1,000.
Bij Voorjaarsnota 2014 worden de algemene uitkering met € – 73.000 neerwaarts en de decentralisatie-uitkeringen met € 1.000 opwaarts bijgesteld.

34085-B.s: The bill amends the 2014 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting new commitment amounts for general, additional, integration and decentralisation grants in line with the autumn budget update. It takes effect from 1 December 2014 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget of expenditure and receipts of the municipal fund for the year 2014
Wij ... hebben ... dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2014

34725-A.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (Slotwet), adjusting appropriations and realised amounts in thousands of euros across road, rail, regional, waterway and mega-project items following technical execution and accounting corrections. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
34725-A.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as purely technical execution, accounting and control-finding adjustments already shared with parliament via earlier letters.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, accounting-related changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

34950-A.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (Slotwet), adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, regional, waterway and mega-project articles, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum states that it contains only technical implementation, bookkeeping and audit-driven adjustments, plus changes already shared with parliament by letter.
34950-A.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments as technical execution changes, bookkeeping mutations, and adjustments following audit findings rather than new powers.
q: This bill includes only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

34960-XVII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), raising total obligations and expenditure within the policy article on social progress. The explanatory memorandum details increases for sexual and reproductive health and rights, women's rights, civil society and education, with multi-year spending adjustments.
q: The commitment budget for article 3 'Social progress' rises by EUR 112 million in 2018.
Het verplichtingenbudget voor artikel 3 «Sociale vooruitgang» stijgt met EUR 112 miljoen in 2018.

35095-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), changing expenditure and revenue figures by policy article as shown in the attached schedule. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force from 1 December 2018 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) for the year 2018 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII) voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35470-C.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) through a closing budget adjustment (Slotwet), fixing the commitment amount for the general grant at €2,146,168,000 and for decentralisation grants at €352,887,000. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is set for the 2019 grant year at €2,146,168,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2019 vastgesteld op € 2.146.168.000.

35570-B.s: The bill formally adopts the 2021 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting the commitment amounts for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It takes effect on 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and supplementary grants is set at €27,550,558,000 for the 2021 grant year.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2021 vastgesteld op € 27.550.558.000.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it had no remarks on the draft 2021 Gemeentefonds budget bill (begrotingsstaat) and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport of 14 September 2020 confirms this and notes only that one non-blank advice concerned the Ministry of Finance budget, with changes handled in annexes.

35650-C.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), raising the general grant commitment to €2,299,076,000 and setting integration and decentralisation grant commitments at €0 and €271,800,000, effective the day after publication and retroactive to 1 December 2020. It is a second supplementary budget with figures in thousands of euros and no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2020
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2020

35830-C.s: This bill adjusts the 2020 budget statement of the provinciefonds, a fund that finances the provinces, through a closing budget law (Slotwet). It sets the general allocation commitment for 2020 at €2,299,076,000 and the integration and decentralisation allocation commitments at €0 and €271,798,000 respectively, and records the realised figures against the adjusted budget.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general allocation is set for allocation year 2020 at €2,299,076,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2020 vastgesteld op € 2.299.076.000.

35850-A.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (first supplementary budget), reallocating commitments, expenditures and receipts across transport, waterways and infrastructure items. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and is retroactive to 1 June 2021.
35850-A.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to delays such as a Raad van State ruling on the PAS, not by any new executive power.
q: Due to delay in the Council of State's ruling, including on the PAS, the start of realisation shifts to 2024.
Door vertraging in de uitspraak van de Raad van State onder andere met betrekking tot PAS schuift de start van de realisatie op naar 2024.

35975-XIX.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds (National Growth Fund), changing commitments, expenditures and receipts across its policy articles and the fund's administration article, with the changes effective from 1 December 2021. It is a technical second supplementary budget with no delegation of rule-making power, and no explanatory memorandum excerpts were provided.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the National Growth Fund (XIX) for the year 2021
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Nationaal Groeifonds (XIX) voor het jaar 2021

36120-J.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (Delta Fund), reallocating commitments, expenditure and receipts across articles such as flood safety, freshwater supply and experimentation under the Delta Act. The bill is a budgetary adjustment with no new delegation of rule-making power and takes effect retroactively from 1 June 2022.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds, all for the year 2022
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds, alle voor het jaar 2022

36200-K.s: The bill sets the 2023 departmental budget statement for the Defence materiel expenditure fund (Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds), with total commitments of about EUR 12.3 billion, expenditure of about EUR 6.7 billion and matching receipts, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum confirms the 'buy off the shelf unless' procurement policy and allows deviation through Fast Track Procurement when off-the-shelf materiel is unavailable, unsuitable or unaffordable.
36200-K.j: The memorandum justifies the deviation from the off-the-shelf rule by the need to acquire materiel quickly when standard options are not timely, suitable, desirable or affordable.
q: If off-the-shelf materiel is not (timely) available, suitable, desirable or affordable, Defence may deviate from the general rule by applying Fast Track Procurement (FTP).
Als materieel van de plank niet (tijdig) beschikbaar, geschikt, wenselijk of betaalbaar is, kan Defensie afwijken van de algemene regel door toepassing van Fast Track Procurement (FTP).
d: budget statement for defence materiel fund
p: Defence may depart from the general off-the-shelf procurement rule through Fast Track Procurement when such materiel is unavailable, unsuitable, undesirable or unaffordable, with project-level reporting to parliament.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division had no remarks on the 2023 budget bill for the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport, sent alongside the other 2023 budget opinions, states that some budgets, including those of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund, required amendments, which are attached as annexes.

36435-A.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the Mobility Fund (Mobiliteitsfonds) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, in line with the supplementary budget presented on Budget Day. The changes are set out in Table 1, with spending and revenue adjustments in thousands of euros, and the law takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 19 September 2023.
q: The budget statement of the Mobility Fund for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Mobiliteitsfonds voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36470-B.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by raising the commitment amounts for the general and additional grants, the integration grants and the decentralisation grants. It also sets the entry-into-force date, applying retroactively from 1 December 2023.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the municipal fund for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2023

36550-C.s: The bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), raising the general grant commitment to €3.318.866.000 and setting integration and decentralisation grant commitments at €0 and €292.024.000. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 June 2024.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36560-B.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting the commitment amounts for the general grant, supplementary grants, integration grants and decentralisation grants for that year. It also sets the bill's entry into force and retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the municipal fund (B) for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van gemeentefonds (B) voor het jaar 2023

36613-C.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the Provinciefonds, raising the commitment amounts for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants to provinces. It also sets the effective date and states that the amounts are in thousands of euros.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is set for grant year 2024 at € 3,554,618,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2024 vastgesteld op € 3.554.618.000.

36625-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (second supplementary budget), adjusting expenditure and commitment figures across policy articles in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2024.
36625-XVII.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by a one-off EUR 3 million contribution to the WHO for combating mpox, funded from unspent higher-education resources, and an early payment to PAHO to relieve a 2025 cut.
q: Coverage is found from unspent funds of the vocational and higher education programme.
Dekking wordt gevonden vanuit niet bestede middelen van het beroeps en hoger onderwijs programma.

36740-B.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) through a closing budget law (slotwet), fixing commitment amounts for the general grant and for integration and decentralisation grants. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We ... have approved and resolved ... The budget statement of the municipal fund (B) for the year 2024 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds (B) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd

36820-C.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the Provinciefonds, raising the commitment amounts for the general and additional grants and the integration and decentralisation grants, and makes the change effective from 16 September 2025. It is a supplementary budget adjustment with no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum available.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Provinciefonds for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2025

36850-XVII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2025 budget for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, adjusting commitments and expenditures across policy articles, with a net increase in expenditure of about EUR 122.6 million and a EUR 14 million receipts change. The bill itself contains no new delegations; it sets budget figures and a retroactive entry-into-force date of 1 December 2025.
36850-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by underspending on civil society programming and the discontinuation of the planned education programme, not by any new executive power.
q: These funds are not needed in 2025 under article 3.3 because spending within the civil society programming is lower than previously expected.
Deze middelen zijn in 2025 niet nodig op artikel 3.3 doordat de uitgaven binnen de programmering op maatschappelijk middenveld lager zijn dan eerder verwacht.
